b1-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Where We Live
b1-10-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you to describe the flat you rent in Budapest and the area around it.
b1-10-01.prompt: Tell Meg where the flat is and what the neighbourhood is like.
b1-10-01.target: Vivimos en un piso que está cerca del centro. El barrio donde vivimos es bastante tranquilo.
b1-10-01.english: We live in a flat that is near the centre. The neighbourhood where we live is quite quiet.
b1-10-01.canDo: I can describe where I live using relative clauses.

b1-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Flats
b1-10-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are comparing two flats in Budapest. The second one is brighter, but the rent is high.
b1-10-02.prompt: Tell Carlos which flat is brighter and what is wrong with the rent.
cues: Say what you think of the rent
b1-10-02.target: Este piso es más luminoso que el otro, aunque el alquiler es demasiado alto.
b1-10-02.english: This flat is brighter than the other, although the rent is too high.
b1-10-02.canDo: I can compare different housing options.

b1-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Pipe Breaks
b1-10-03.scenario: You are Carlos. A pipe broke in the kitchen while you and Meg were sleeping. Your colleague at the office asks what happened.
b1-10-03.prompt: Tell what happened and what you did.
b1-10-03.target: Mientras dormíamos, una tubería se rompió, así que llamamos al propietario.
b1-10-03.english: While we were sleeping, a pipe broke, so we called the landlord.
b1-10-03.canDo: I can narrate a household problem clearly.

b1-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Would You Change?
b1-10-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you would change in your flat if you could.
b1-10-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what you would do and why.
cues: Say what you would enlarge or renovate
b1-10-04.target: Si pudiera, ampliaría el salón porque necesito más espacio.
b1-10-04.english: If I could, I would enlarge the living room because I need more space.
b1-10-04.canDo: I can discuss hypothetical changes to a home.

b1-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: An Imperfect Flat
b1-10-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You have read a story about a narrator whose flat was worse than the advert. Tell Meg about it and say what home you would prefer.
b1-10-05.prompt: Tell Meg what happened to the narrator and what kind of home you would prefer.
cues: Say what the flat was like in the photos
Say what home you would prefer
b1-10-05.target: El piso parecía perfecto en las fotos, pero era más pequeño. Yo preferiría una vivienda funcional y tranquila.
b1-10-05.english: The flat looked perfect in the photos, but it was smaller. I would prefer a functional, quiet home.
b1-10-05.canDo: I can describe and evaluate an ideal home.

b1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Perfect Home
b1-10-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what kind of home you would like in Budapest.
b1-10-consolidation.prompt: Describe your perfect home and say why.
cues: Say what it would be like
b1-10-consolidation.target: Mi vivienda perfecta sería más luminosa que este piso y tendría bastante privacidad porque necesito trabajar.
b1-10-consolidation.english: My ideal home would be brighter than this flat and would have enough privacy because I need to work.
b1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate housing and description language.
